title: Mila
description: Create and manage documents, spreadsheets, and presentations from your AI assistant.
summary: Create and manage documents, spreadsheets, and presentations from your AI assistant.
offersHint: Create and manage documents, spreadsheets, and presentations from your AI assistant. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.mila.gg/

toolsPreview.name: list_servers
toolsPreview.description: List all workspaces (servers) you have access to.

toolsPreview.name: list_documents
toolsPreview.description: List all documents (docs, word, notes, pages). Use this when asked to list, find, or search documents, notes, drafts, or written content. Supports pagination, sorting, and filtering by workspace.

toolsPreview.name: get_document
toolsPreview.description: Get a document (doc, word, note, page) by ID, including its full content (title, HTML body, metadata).

toolsPreview.name: create_document
toolsPreview.description:
Create a new document. Use this when asked to create, write, draft, or compose a document, doc, note, page, article, or word document. Content should be HTML (e.g. "

Hello

").

toolsPreview.name: update_document
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing document (doc, word, note). Supply a new title and/or HTML content to replace the body.

toolsPreview.name: delete_document
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a document (doc, word, note) by ID.

toolsPreview.name: append_to_document
toolsPreview.description: Append HTML content to the end of an existing document (doc, word, note) without replacing existing content.

toolsPreview.name: list_sheets
toolsPreview.description: List all spreadsheets (sheets, excel, workbooks) with their tab metadata (no cell data). Use this when asked to list, find, or search spreadsheets, workbooks, tables, or tabular data.

toolsPreview.name: get_sheet
toolsPreview.description: Get a spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook) by ID, including all tabs and their cell data in A1 notation.

toolsPreview.name: create_sheet
toolsPreview.description: Create a new spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook) with an initial tab. Use this when asked to create a spreadsheet, table, workbook, tracker, or organize data in rows and columns.

toolsPreview.name: update_sheet
toolsPreview.description: Update spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook) workbook-level properties (currently only title).

toolsPreview.name: delete_sheet
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook) and all its tabs.

toolsPreview.name: get_sheet_tab
toolsPreview.description: Get a single tab from a spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook), including all cell data in A1 notation.

toolsPreview.name: create_sheet_tab
toolsPreview.description: Add a new tab to a spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook).

toolsPreview.name: update_sheet_tab
toolsPreview.description: Update a spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook) tab: merge cells, rename, change color, or resize the grid. Set a cell value to null to clear it.

toolsPreview.name: delete_sheet_tab
toolsPreview.description: Delete a tab from a spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook). Cannot delete the last remaining tab.

toolsPreview.name: append_rows
toolsPreview.description: Append one or more rows of data to a spreadsheet (sheet, excel, workbook) tab. Use "rows" for multiple rows or "values" for a single row.

toolsPreview.name: list_slides
toolsPreview.description: List all slide presentations (slides, powerpoint, deck, keynote). Use this when asked to list, find, or search presentations, decks, or slideshows.

toolsPreview.name: get_slide_presentation
toolsPreview.description: Get a slide presentation (slides, powerpoint, deck, keynote) by ID, including all slide data.

toolsPreview.name: create_slide_presentation
toolsPreview.description: Create a new slide presentation (slides, powerpoint, deck, keynote). Use this when asked to create a presentation, slide deck, or slideshow. Each slide has "html" content and optional "background" and "notes".

toolsPreview.name: update_slide_presentation
toolsPreview.description: Update a slide presentation (slides, powerpoint, deck, keynote): title, slide data, theme, or aspect ratio.

toolsPreview.name: delete_slide_presentation
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a slide presentation (slides, powerpoint, deck, keynote).

toolsPreview.name: append_slides
toolsPreview.description: Append one or more slides to an existing presentation (slides, powerpoint, deck, keynote).
